interpretation: One row is one supplied source proposal. A bounded-rule-or-source-step link means a specific operation or measurement overlaps, not that the whole historical proposal was executed or closed. A context-only link is explanatory and must never count as a replay. An extension marked runnable is a newly declared variant unless all historical parameters can be pinned. These counts are deduplicated by source proposal and by record ID; cases within a record are not counted as new proposals.
